lastGenerated.description: The date and time of when the generation of the most recent report was initiated.

inProgress.description: When true, the request was successful and the report is being generated. If false, the request was unsuccessful and the report is not being generated.

queued.description: The date and time of when a successful request was queued for the most recent report.

success.description: True if the requested report was successfully queued and false if the requested report was not able to be queued.

errorMessage.description: Error details in case the report generation request was unsuccessful.

lastInvocationId.description: A unique ID generated for this request.

fileSize.description: The file size in Bytes is populated upon successful generation of the report.

excelReportTypes.description: The type of the report requested in the query string.
